trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You have drifted into shadow. The moons grow distant; the Lattice loosens toward the dark between the stars.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The Lunar Lattice holds you. Night vision is keener after dark; outdoor night life and caravan kinship are felt as devotion.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The moons have noticed how you move. Stamina Regeneration +5% (at night), Disease Resistance +15% (at night).

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: The Lattice holds you steady. Outdoor night travel carries more; cold and storms press lighter; full moons strengthen the day's devotion.

deity_tone: Khenarthi: Wind-voiced, road-knowing, merciful; speaks of passage, of arriving when needed, of the open sky; always moving.
trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Khenarthi names you to the road. Sprinting outdoors drains 15% less stamina; storms no longer chill you; outdoor sleep restores health and stamina both.

deity_tone: Azurah: Twilight-voiced, threshold-knowing; the mother who shaped the Khajiit; speaks of fate and the hinges of the world; tender and certain.
trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Azurah watches your thresholds. Spells cost 10% less at night and 15% less at dawn and dusk. The hinges of the world turn where you stand.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Baan Dar walks with the pariah. Once a week, a near-fatal escape returns a day-long pulse of fortune. Acts beyond the city walls weigh heavier.

deity_tone: Rajhin: A performer's voice, delighted, legend-making; speaks of theft as art and of the story worth telling; never petty.
trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Rajhin marks the artful thief. A theft from a notable target opens a brief unseen window; the first strike of a fight cuts deeper.

deity_tone: Alkosh: Rare, immense, order-keeping; the dragon-lord; speaks of cosmic chaos held back and the line that must not break.
trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Alkosh keeps the cosmic line. Your resistance to fire rises by 15%, and felling a named dragon grants a two-day blessing of order.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per save.
draft_prose: The moons have noticed how you move. Observant.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per save.
draft_prose: The Lattice holds you steady now. Faithful.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per direction per save.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per direction per save.
draft_prose: The Lattice holds you more thinly. Observant.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Fires once at dawn when emphasis shifts None to a deity; %s is the emerging deity.
draft_prose: Your devotion has been leaning toward %s. The moons already knew.

deity_tone: Khenarthi: Wind-voiced, road-knowing, merciful; speaks of passage, of arriving when needed, of the open sky; always moving.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Khenarthi Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Khenarthi's Road" Body: "The wind has carried you so long it has learned your name. Walk, and the road walks with you. The open sky was always your temple roof."

deity_tone: Khenarthi: Wind-voiced, road-knowing, merciful; speaks of passage, of arriving when needed, of the open sky; always moving.
trigger: HUD corner notification. Khenarthi Devoted + open-road travel; one per in-game day.
draft_prose: The road runs easy under you. Khenarthi's wind is at your back.

deity_tone: Azurah: Twilight-voiced, threshold-knowing; the mother who shaped the Khajiit; speaks of fate and the hinges of the world; tender and certain.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Azurah Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Azurah's Twilight" Body: "I shaped the Khajiit at the first dusk. I have watched you stand at every threshold since. You feel the world's hinges now. Cross well."

deity_tone: Azurah: Twilight-voiced, threshold-knowing; the mother who shaped the Khajiit; speaks of fate and the hinges of the world; tender and certain.
trigger: HUD corner notification. Azurah Devoted + threshold beat; one per in-game day.
draft_prose: A threshold ahead. Azurah's twilight goes before you.

trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Baan Dar Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Baan Dar's Favor" Body: "The world offered you nothing, exile, and you made a life of it anyway. That is my whole gospel. When the reversal should have killed you, look for my hand."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Baan Dar Devoted + improbable survival; weekly cap.
draft_prose: You should not have walked away from that. Baan Dar's hand.

deity_tone: Rajhin: A performer's voice, delighted, legend-making; speaks of theft as art and of the story worth telling; never petty.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Rajhin Devoted; Entry-only.
draft_prose: Title: "Rajhin's Touch" Body: "The Footpad himself stole from an Emperor and wore Mephala's ring. You steal as though a story is being told. It is. I am telling it."

deity_tone: Alkosh: Rare, immense, order-keeping; the dragon-lord; speaks of cosmic chaos held back and the line that must not break.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Alkosh Devoted; Entry-only.
draft_prose: Title: "Alkosh's Line" Body: "Lorkhaj's chaos gnaws at the seams of the world. Few are asked to hold the line against it. You were. You held. The dragon-lord knows your face."

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: Too long indoors and walled in. The Lattice holds you more thinly.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing; %s is the focus deity.
draft_prose: %s sends less than you had grown used to. The lean is fading.

trigger: HUD corner notification. One per lapse-band crossing.
draft_prose: The caravans do not know your face. You have not been where they go.

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: You walk inside the Lunar Lattice, broad and unfocused, held by the moons and the road. Standing: %s. No god leads yet, and that is whole.

trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.
draft_prose: The Lattice holds you, and %s1 leads your devotion now. Standing: %s2. You did not choose it; you were walking it.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; daily cap; no fast-travel.
draft_prose: The road carries you kindly tonight. The moons are near.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; cooldown per caravan encounter.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental; Khenarthi emphasis.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; real threshold required.

trigger: HUD corner notification. Momentary combat; adversity filter; cooldown.

trigger: MessageBox. Weekly cap; near-fatal escape only.
draft_prose: Title: "Pariah's Fortune" Body: "That was not survivable, and you survived it. The god of pariahs wrote you a way out, because once, someone should have done the same for him."

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; notable target; no petty-theft spam.
draft_prose: A theft worth a story. Rajhin is delighted.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; named dragon or order-keeping beat.
draft_prose: A dragon down, the line held. Alkosh marks the order kept.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On designating an anchor (max 2-3).
draft_prose: You have made this a road home. The circuit has an anchor here.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On returning to an anchor after cycling; not repeat-camping.
draft_prose: Back at a road home, the circuit holding. The Lattice steadies.

trigger: HUD corner notification. On cadence lapse.
draft_prose: You have not walked the circuit in too long. The anchors grow cold.

trigger: MessageBox. Once on becoming vampire.
draft_prose: Title: "The Lattice Corrupted" Body: "The thirst has taken you, little moon. The Lattice does not cast you out -- the moons do not disown their own -- but the caravans will fear you, and rightly. I will not look away. Few of the others can say the same."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on cure; clears posture toward Normal.
draft_prose: Title: "The Lattice Clears" Body: "The thirst is gone. The corruption lifts from the Lattice, and the caravans may learn your face again. Walk back into the moonlight. It was always waiting."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation.
draft_prose: Title: "A Competing Shape" Body: "Hircine has given you another shape. The moons are about form, and you carry one too many now. You are still Khajiit -- strained, watched, but not erased. The community will fear the wolf. Hold to the road."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on werewolf cure; clears posture toward Normal.
draft_prose: Title: "One Shape Again" Body: "The wolf is set down, little moon. The Lattice holds a single shape once more, and the extra form no longer pulls against the moons. The caravans will lose their fear in time. The road is yours again."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on entering ShadowDrift; voice deviation justified above.
draft_prose: Title: "The Shadow Between Stars" Body: "You have lived too long in the shadow -- night-only, predatory, drawn to the dark between the moons. The Lattice loosens its hold. Khenarthi's road and Azurah's twilight both feel far away now."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on leaving ShadowDrift; pairs with ShadowDriftEntry.
draft_prose: Title: "Back Under the Moons" Body: "You have turned from the dark between the stars and walked back into the moonlight. The Lattice tightens its hold again, and Khenarthi's road and Azurah's twilight return to you. The drift is ended."

trigger: Dialogue topic; Faithful or above.
draft_prose: "I walk the road and the moons walk with me. What does the caravan need?"

trigger: Dialogue topic; Any tier.
draft_prose: "The Lattice holds me. Speak of the moons, and of Riddle'Thar."
